name: Leviathan
description: The tallest and fastest roller coaster in Canada — Leviathan is a breathtaking giga coaster that soars 93 metres above Canada's Wonderland before plunging riders into a massive 80-degree drop at 148 km/h through a spectacular layout of sweeping high-speed turns and airtime hills. One of the greatest and most admired giga coasters in the world. Min 137cm.

name: Yukon Striker
description: The world's fastest, tallest and longest dive coaster — Yukon Striker holds a world record-breaking 90-degree vertical drop of 75 metres, a stomach-dropping hold at the top of the dive and an extraordinary 90-metre underwater tunnel element. The most thrilling and acclaimed coaster addition to Canada's Wonderland. Min 130cm.

name: Behemoth
description: A massive and iconic hyper coaster at Canada's Wonderland delivering 11 airtime hills through a sprawling layout with spectacular views over the park and surrounding Toronto landscape. Behemoth is one of the most beloved coasters in Canada and delivers one of the most sustained airtime experiences at any North American park. Min 137cm.

name: Shockwave
description: A unique and intense stand-up roller coaster at Canada's Wonderland delivering loops and inversions in a distinctive upright riding position — one of the most unusual and memorable coaster experiences in Canada. Min 137cm.

name: Time Warp
description: A classic flying coaster at Canada's Wonderland placing riders in a prone flying position through loops and inversions — Time Warp is one of the most uniquely themed and atmospheric coasters at the park. Min 137cm.

name: Vortex
description: A classic suspended looping coaster at Canada's Wonderland sending riders through multiple inversions in a swinging suspended vehicle — Vortex has been a beloved Canadian park institution since 1991. Min 122cm.

name: The Bat
description: A thrilling inverted coaster delivering sweeping turns and inversions through the treetops — The Bat provides an excellent inverted coaster experience and is one of the most popular mid-tier coasters at Canada's Wonderland. Min 122cm.

name: Backlot Stunt Coaster
description: A thrilling and entertaining Hollywood stunt-themed launched coaster featuring fire effects, water jets and a helicopter crash scene — Backlot Stunt Coaster is one of the most popular and rerideable family thrill coasters at Canada's Wonderland. Min 122cm.

name: Wild Beast
description: A classic wooden roller coaster at Canada's Wonderland delivering traditional wooden coaster thrills with genuine rough-and-tumble character. Wild Beast is one of the oldest and most nostalgic attractions at the park and a beloved Canadian institution. Min 122cm.

name: Mighty Canadian Minebuster
description: A classic Canadian wooden coaster and original 1981 park icon — Mighty Canadian Minebuster delivers beloved old-school wooden coaster character and is one of the most nostalgic and cherished attractions at Canada's Wonderland. Min 122cm.

name: Dragon Fire
description: A classic double loop and corkscrew steel coaster and original Canada's Wonderland icon — Dragon Fire has delivered intense inversions to Canadian park visitors since 1981 and remains a beloved original attraction. Min 130cm.

name: Wonder Mountain's Guardian
description: A spectacular indoor dark ride inside the iconic Wonder Mountain — Wonder Mountain's Guardian is an elaborate interactive shooter dark ride combining state-of-the-art projection screens, animatronic figures and multiple shooting targets. The most unique and immersive dark ride experience at any Canadian theme park. Suitable for all ages.

name: Dare Devil Dive
description: A spectacular skydiving simulation experience at Canada's Wonderland that catapults riders skyward in a free-fall descent from 30 metres — one of the most unique and thrilling non-coaster experiences at the park. Min 122cm.

name: Planet Snoopy
description: One of the largest and most elaborate children's zones at any North American theme park — Planet Snoopy at Canada's Wonderland features over 20 rides and attractions for young children themed to the beloved Peanuts characters. The most complete and magical children's theme park zone in Canada. Suitable for all ages.
